scope: Proposition 7.1 (One-source limits) of the manuscript “Conformal universality of bulk Ising correlations under weak interactions” (preprints/Conformal-universality-of-bulk-Ising-correlations-under-weak-interactions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8a815e7845436e07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 44. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are real analytic functions Zσ(λ) and Zϵ(λ) on a neighborhood of zero, with Zσ(0) = Zϵ(0) = 1, such that the plane one-source lists on the critical trajectory satisfy uℓ j = Zℓ(λ)v (dℓ) j + ηℓ j, ‖ ‖ ‖ηℓ j ‖ ‖ ‖ rj,• −→ 0. (7.4) Here Zℓ is Zσ for a spin and Zϵ for any incident bond orientation; energy lists are understood modulo constants. The convergence is locally uniform in the coupling. The two functions are nonzero on one smaller coupling interval, independently of domains, boundary conditions, and the number of sources.
